title: Canon state: a storm is lashing the valley; the sky cannot be clear

history.content: Aria: I look out of the inn's common room window.
{"actions": [{"type": "narrate", "text": "Rain hammers the shutters in waves. The storm has lashed the valley since dusk, and the street outside is a river of mud lit by lightning."}]}

canon_facts.fact: A storm is lashing the valley; it is raining hard.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I pull on my cloak and step outside into the street.

actions.text: The rain hits you like a thrown bucket. Wind rips the door from your hand and slams it behind you, and the street ahead is ankle-deep in runoff, lit white by a crack of lightning.
